verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for an observability SaaS like Better Stack, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents region selection or data residency. The 'EU, US West, and Asia/Pacific' mentions describe on-call schedule time zones, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
